title: NSE fixes IPO price band at ₹1,700-1,785; issue opens September 17
text: NSE fixes IPO price band at ₹1,700-1,785; issue opens September 17. The National Stock Exchange is set to begin its public offering next week after receiving regulatory clearance for the long-awaited issue.
